name: What are street noise reduction windows and how do they work?

mainEntity.name: What are street noise reduction windows and how do they work?

acceptedAnswer.text: Street noise reduction windows, also known as soundproof or acoustic windows, are designed to minimize the amount of external noise entering your home. They typically achieve this through several features: thicker glass panes, often laminated or double-paned with a specialized air gap or gas fill, and robust frames that create an airtight seal. This multi-layered construction reduces sound vibrations and prevents noise from transmitting through the window, offering a quieter indoor environment. The effectiveness is measured by the Sound Transmission Class (STC) rating, where higher numbers indicate better noise reduction.
acceptedAnswer.description: Street noise reduction windows use thicker, often multi-pane glass and specialized frames to block external noise from entering your home. They work by reducing sound vibrations and creating an airtight seal.
